title: My first ㅍ became π, # and a dog 😭 #learnkorean
caption:
ㅍ (say "pee-eup") is written in 4 strokes:
1 top line
2 left line
3 right line
4 bottom line (a little longer)

Keep the two short lines between the top and bottom lines — if they poke out, it turns into #.
Easy way to remember: a little dog standing on the floor. Top = its back, bottom = the floor.

SYNK LAB
#learnkorean #studykorean #hangul #koreanalphabet
pinnedComment: Be honest — was your first ㅍ a π, a # or a dog? 👇
alt: Top-down view of a Korean handwriting notebook with a pencil. In four practice boxes, a gray model letter ㅍ sits top-left; the pencil's first try curls into the math symbol π, the second pokes its lines through and becomes a hashtag, the third grows a head and a tail and turns into a little dog. The page flips: one big box shows the real way in four numbered strokes — top, left, right, bottom — and a red pen labels them back, leg, leg, floor, then adds a head and a wagging tail. The name card reads ㅍ = 피읖, say pee-eup. At the end the three tries come back small: π and # are crossed out, the dog gets a big red check.
